metadata.name: skech
metadata.description: skech on Solana: draw ink ahead of the Bitcoin price, and the ink the price runs through pays

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Set the game up: only the program's upgrade authority, who becomes its admin. `cluster` names where it runs
("devnet", "mainnet-beta", "localnet") and goes into every signed piece.

instructions.name: place
docs: Place one piece. `piece` must be the first argument: its bytes are what the session key signed.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the transaction and the bet's rent, and gets the rent back when the bet is closed.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Attests the quote by signing. Usually the payer too.

accounts.name: bet
docs: The new bet, at seeds [BET_SEED, player, drawing, index]: created here only if the piece goes in.

accounts.name: rent_receiver
docs: Gets back the rent of the bets closed here: only those it paid for are closed.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Whoever sends it. If it is not the holder, they earn the house a cut of the growth.

accounts.name: from
docs: The player's own token account, on which they approved the game as delegate. Only their own tokens, into
their own balance: nothing else can be moved this way.

errors.name: BadBar
errors.msg: The bar is malformed or early

errors.name: BarConflict
errors.msg: A different bar is already posted for that second

errors.name: BarDiscontinuous
errors.msg: The bar does not follow on from the second before

errors.name: BadSettleAccounts
errors.msg: Settle accounts must come in (bet, player) pairs

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program's upgrade authority may initialize

errors.name: BarLate
errors.msg: The bar is too late to post

types.name: Bar
docs: One second of the price, 8 decimals: from the second before's close to this one's high, low and close.

fields.name: second
docs: The second it is, ms since the epoch on the exchange's clock; 0 is an empty slot.

types.name: Bars
docs: The last `BAR_RING` seconds of a market's price, one slot per second. A slot is reused when its second comes
round again, and never by an older one: a second, once posted, is that bar for as long as anything can read it.

fields.name: last
docs: The latest second posted, ms.

types.name: BetSection
docs: A band of a bet as placed: `lo` to `hi` (8 decimals, on the grid), `second` seconds after it opens, staking
`stake` and paying `rung` (x100) if the price reaches it.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Of every stake, as it is placed, to the house.

fields.name: profit_fee_bps
docs: Of every hit's profit, to the house.

fields.name: sweep_bps
docs: Of an IOU's growth, to whoever redeems it for someone else.

fields.name: late_ms
docs: How late after its opening second the oracle may have received a piece, ms.

fields.name: place_grace_ms
docs: How far from its opening second a placement may land, and how early a second may be posted, ms.

fields.name: max_price_age_ms
docs: How old the price a player saw may be when the oracle received the piece, ms.

fields.name: min_per_dot
docs: What a dot may cost, USDC e6.

fields.name: max_piece_stake
docs: The most one piece may stake, USDC e6.

fields.name: min_redeem
docs: The least a partial IOU redemption may be worth, USDC e6.

fields.name: max_session_secs
docs: How far ahead a session may be set to expire, seconds.

fields.name: swept
docs: Swept from the wallet on its standing approval, rather than sent by it.

types.name: Game
docs: The game: who runs it, what it trades in, and its terms. Its PDA owns the vault.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Set by `propose_admin`, takes over on `accept_admin`: an admin is never handed to a key that cannot sign.

fields.name: oracle
docs: Signs every placement (its quote) and every bar.

fields.name: token_program
docs: The token program the mint is under: SPL Token for USDC, Token-2022 allowed.

fields.name: vault
docs: Every player's USDC, the pool and the fees: the game PDA's associated token account.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Where collected fees go: a token account of the treasury (a multisig on mainnet).

fields.name: domain
docs: What every piece a session key signs starts with: sha256("skech/v1" || program id || cluster), so a
signature for devnet never places on mainnet, or on another deployment.

fields.name: difficulty
docs: 0 to 100: how hard the game is here. Pieces placed from now on pay by it.

fields.name: name
docs: What the engine calls it: "BTC-USD".

types.name: Owed
docs: `to` is owed `value` as IOU shares; the house when `to` is the default key.

types.name: PieceMessage
docs: What a player's session key signs: a piece of a drawing, bet as it is drawn.

fields.name: domain
docs: `Game.domain`: this deployment on this cluster.

fields.name: player
docs: The player's wallet.

fields.name: drawing
docs: The drawing this piece is part of, and its number within it: together they name the bet.

fields.name: difficulty
docs: The difficulty the player was shown. If the market's has changed since, the piece is refused.

fields.name: open_at
docs: The second it opens on, ms. Its bands are 1 to 30 seconds after it.

fields.name: per_dot
docs: What one dot costs, USDC e6.

fields.name: unit
docs: The price grid the bands sit on, 8 decimals: bands are judged one unit wider each way.

fields.name: price_seen
docs: The price on the player's screen when they drew, and its time, as the engine signed it (checked by the oracle).

fields.name: stroke_hash
docs: sha256 of the stroke's points. The stroke itself stays with the relayer: it is too big for a transaction.

types.name: Placed
docs: A piece went in. `refunded` is the stake of bands not offered, which never left the balance.

types.name: Player
docs: A player: their balance in the game, their session and what they are owed. Keyed by their wallet.

fields.name: balance
docs: USDC e6, theirs to play with or take out.

fields.name: iou_shares
docs: IOU shares they hold, and what they were owed when those were issued.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who paid this account's rent; it goes back to them if the account is ever closed.

types.name: Pool
docs: The money that is not anyone's balance: what backs live stakes and pays hits, and the house's fees.

fields.name: pool
docs: USDC backing live stakes and paying hits, e6.

fields.name: fees
docs: Fees taken and not yet collected, e6.

fields.name: iou_index_at
docs: An IOU share's value at `iou_time_at`, x1e18, rising by `iou_rate` every second.

fields.name: iou_shares
docs: Every share outstanding, the house's included.

fields.name: house_shares
docs: What the house is owed in fees the pool could not pay at once.

types.name: QuoteArgs
docs: What the oracle attests about a piece, by signing the transaction that carries it: the market on its opening
second and each band's chance, measured off chain on thousands of real price paths.

fields.name: price
docs: The price the second before `open_at` closed at, 8 decimals.

fields.name: momentum
docs: The last three seconds' move in volatilities, x1e6.

fields.name: received_at
docs: When the oracle received the piece, ms.

fields.name: chances
docs: Each band's chance, in billionths, in the piece's order.

types.name: SectionArg
docs: A band, as signed: `lo` and `hi` are counted in grid units (so they sit on the grid by construction), `stake` in
USDC e6. 11 bytes.

fields.name: second
docs: Seconds after the piece opens, 1 to 30.

fields.name: lo
docs: The band's bottom, in units of `unit` from zero.

fields.name: width
docs: Its height, in units.

types.name: Session
docs: A player's session key: an Ed25519 key their app keeps, which may place pieces for them, up to an allowance,
until it expires. It can never withdraw.

fields.name: valid_until
docs: Unix seconds, by the chain's clock.

fields.name: allowance
docs: USDC e6 the session may still stake.

types.name: Settled
docs: Bands decided: `paid` USDC into the balance, `owed` as IOU.

fields.name: closed
docs: Every band decided: the bet is closed.

fields.name: expired_mask
docs: Bands whose second can no longer be posted, given back by `expire`, and what they gave back (in `paid` and
`owed` with the rest).
